data.body: 2026-09-27: chat.e1608e3b0f642edccf7dcb59588deb2a61dbd0fb died after 61m at "context preparation failed: Invalid model context: provider failed: provider tool request is invalid". The parent's retry_notice enumerated 49 uncollected subagent jobs; 5291B crossed the 4 KiB MAX_RETRY_NOTICE_BYTES and the loop made it node-fatal. Normative: aworkit.workflow_worker.failure_policy - no limit ends a run; report every condition to the model as a bounded notice; only the final answer, cancellation, or an unrecoverable authority denial terminate a node.
